picks.title: Elvis Presley Rights Owners Sue Suno Over AI Voice Cloning: 'Elvis' Identity Was Stolen'
picks.excerpt: A new lawsuit from Elvis Presley's rights owners claims Suno violated the singer's likeness rights by letting users clone his famous voice; Eminem's publisher Eight Mile Style filed a separate $41M suit the same day - new filings, not a continuation of the earlier Suno cases.
picks.rationale: A new likeness-rights suit against Suno over voice cloning, separate from the Elvis estate's 10-25 training suit against Anthropic, which tests whether letting users clone a famous voice is unlawful.

picks.title: Sampleson Wavefinder Uses Local AI To Search Audio Libraries By Sound
picks.excerpt: Sampleson's new desktop app Wavefinder skips filenames and tags: a locally run AI model analyses your sample library and ranks sounds by similarity to a text description or a reference recording, with no uploads or subscription.
picks.rationale: A new tool producers can use tomorrow: an on-device AI that searches a sample library by sound or text description, with no uploads and no subscription.

picks.title: Heritage Audio's i73 Pro gains NAM A2 support
picks.excerpt: A firmware update lets Heritage Audio's i73 Pro interfaces run Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) A2 machine-learning amp captures directly on their internal DSP, bringing neural amp models into hardware.
picks.rationale: A firmware release that runs Neural Amp Modeler captures on an audio interface's own DSP. Earlier cards covered NAM in pedals, and this brings it to recording interfaces.

picks.title: ProCraft: Instruction-Driven Music Production from Free-Form Text
picks.excerpt: ProCraft is a 0.5B-parameter codec language model that edits 30-second music excerpts end-to-end from free-form instructions, including compound requests - seven operations across eight instruments, from track removal to accompaniment generation.
picks.rationale: A small model that edits a mix from plain-language instructions, including compound edits like removing a track and generating accompaniment, which points toward instruction-driven production tools.

picks.title: AI meme era hits K-pop — and even tycoons are dancing to 'Neon'
picks.excerpt: A2O Lite's 'Neon' choreography went viral through AI-generated meme videos putting celebrities and tycoons in the dance - a promotion win that also brings new likeness/legal liability for K-pop labels. (Off-list.)
picks.rationale: AI-generated meme videos became a K-pop promotion channel, and they bring likeness and legal risk for labels. No earlier card covered this.
